title: The AI built to tell your food apart from a weed, then shoot the weed
title_candidates: How an NVIDIA-powered farming robot kills weeds with lasers, not chemicals

The farming robot quietly replacing weed killer on real fields
Watch this farming robot fire a laser at every weed it spots
The AI built to tell your food apart from a weed, then shoot the weed
caption:
This machine uses AI vision to identify weeds among crops, then fires a precision laser to kill them in milliseconds. No herbicides, no damage to anything growing next to them.

The hard part has always been telling a weed from a food crop fast enough to act. NVIDIA's vision chip makes that call quick enough to work while the machine keeps moving across a real field. Traditional weed killers can't make that distinction, so they spray everything and hope for the best.

If this scales, chemical weed killers become optional. That's a bigger deal for food and soil than most people realize.
